天刚蒙蒙亮，王野就吃过早饭拿着枪去了三爷爷家，同样是背着背篓拿着柴刀。跟着三爷爷上山，到了近山的一处空旷的地方。三爷爷简单教了王野一下怎样开枪，并嘱咐他早点回去不用等他，就自己进山了。

王野开始一枪一枪的练着，王野发现用上精神力开枪，那真是百发百中。这让王野高兴的不得了。摸了一下兜里还剩七十多发子弹，出发开始自由活动。

释放自己的精神力，发现可以探查一百来米的景象。不由得有一阵吐槽：“麻麻批！人家一探查这座山都知道哪儿有猎物，我倒好，一百米，TMD一百米我用探查呀？我不会自己看呀？我又不瞎！”

说是这样说，探查肯定比看要清楚，就是一只蚂蚁，王野想探查都能看清他有几条腿。

要是被人知道王野有这些腹诽，一定破口大骂：“你TM一个开挂的，还嫌挂不好用，你也是个人了。”

边走边探查，没走多远，就看见前面有几只兔子。

王野暗自窃喜，这不中午饭就来了吗。悄悄靠近，举枪开枪拉栓再开枪，一气呵成。当再次拉好栓时，兔子已经跑没影了。

王野看着手里的三八大盖顿时就不香了，这要是给他一把56半，这几只兔子一只都跑不了。算了，别想了，就自己这种小老百姓，还想染指56半？算了吧！四年前才定型生产的，现在都没有列装完呢。这要是在黑市出现一把，得把你八辈儿祖宗都查的清清楚楚。

捡起两只兔子，收进空间。继续前进，走走停停，靠着精神力的加持，王野也算是收获满满。七只兔子，十只野鸡。王野到了一条小溪旁。开着精神力，又走了这么久。虽然还没到中午，王野早就饥肠辘辘了。

埋锅造饭，从空间里拿出在供销社买的大锅，找了一堆石头垒起一个简单的土灶，又找到一棵枯死的大树，收进空间，瞬间加工成柴火。猎物在空间里剥皮清理一气呵成，那叫一个美滋滋。

这会儿，王野也不说空间九块九包邮了。现在也不用太讲究味道，野鸡兔子一锅出。有人就要问了，为啥不烤着吃呢？答案很简单，累了，太累了，哪有功夫烤呀！

收拾好一切，又在空间里用木头做了一个锅盖，开炖。做完一切，王野也累的不想动了。靠在一棵大树下，开始闭目养神，这在山里可不敢睡觉。万一来点什么不速之客，自己的小命要紧。

眼看要到中午了，锅里也传来浓郁的香气。掀锅开吃。一时间风卷残云，过了一个来小时，随着一声饱嗝。吃饱了，真吃饱了。

吃饱喝足，王野把剩下的肉连锅一起收进空间。王野背起长枪拿着柴刀，一边溜达一边继续寻找猎物，一路走来，打到了不少东西，还是只有野鸡野兔这种小东西。走着走着就走到了一处山谷，精神力还没探查到，就先看见了一群野猪正在顺着山谷往前走。

王野悄悄地跟了上去，老远一看，两头大的，五头小的，王野心想：“好家伙，这是一家子呀！”

大的野猪有小两百斤，小的也有四五十斤。王野心想：“这要是开枪，就算一枪一头，最多也就是两头大的。剩下五头那也是两百多斤呢！”

本着浪费可耻的精神，王野想继续尾随，寻找机会。

这一走就是一个来小时。就在王野要失去耐性的时候，这群野猪来到了山谷的尽头。王野看着眼前景象，三面环山，一个小瀑布从山上流下，王野躲在一块巨石后观察着。那小瀑布落下形成了一个水潭，周围水草丰茂，看来这群野猪经常来这里觅食。

野猪们警惕性很高，发现这边有点动静，纷纷抬起头看向王野所在方向。王野屏住呼吸一动不动。好在野猪看了会儿没发现危险，便又低下头吃草喝水。山谷的谷口有三十多米宽，王野费劲的爬上谷口一块得有三米多高的巨石上。

在确保自己安全后，举枪射击，枪枪爆头，野猪们无路可逃，只能向谷口奔跑，五枪过后，剩下一大一小，眼看就要跑到谷口，擦！没子弹了，三八大盖只能装五发子弹。

这要是重新装弹，这两只早就跑没影了，说时迟那时快，王野心想：“我踏马一个有空间的挂逼，能让你们从我眼前跑了？”

At dawn, Wang Ye had breakfast and went to the third grandfather's house with a gun and a hatchet on his back.I followed Third Grandpa up the mountain to an open place near the mountain.Third Grandpa briefly taught Wang Ye how to shoot, and told him to go back early without waiting for him, and then went into the mountain by himself.

Wang Ye began to practice shooting one shot at a time. Wang Ye found that when he used his mental power to shoot, he could hit the target with perfect accuracy.This made Wang Ye extremely happy.After checking there were more than 70 rounds of ammunition left in his pocket, he set out to start some free activities.

Release your mental power and discover that you can explore a scene about a hundred meters away.I couldn't help but complain for a while: "Mom! People will know where there is prey when they explore this mountain. It's better for me. One hundred meters, why should I explore for one hundred meters? I can't see by myself? I'm not blind!"

Having said that, probing is definitely better than seeing. Even if it is an ant, Wang Ye can clearly see how many legs it has even if he probes.

If someone knew that Wang Ye had these slanders, they would definitely yell at him: "You are a cheater, and you think cheating is not easy to use. You are also a human being."

While walking and exploring, I didn't go far when I saw a few rabbits in front of me.

Wang Ye secretly rejoiced, lunch would come before noon.Approach quietly, raise the gun, shoot, pull the bolt, and then fire, all in one go.When the bolt was pulled again, the rabbit had disappeared.

Wang Ye looked at the Sanba Gai in his hand and immediately felt bad. If he was given a 56 and a half, none of these rabbits would be able to escape.Forget it, don't think about it, a common man like me still wants to get involved in 56 and a half?Forget it!It was finalized and produced four years ago, and it has not yet been installed.If this appears on the black market, eight generations of your ancestors will have to be traced.

Pick up two rabbits and put them into the space.Continuing to move forward, stop and go, relying on the blessing of spiritual power, Wang Ye has gained a lot.Seven rabbits and ten pheasants.Wang Ye arrived at a small stream.With my mental power on, I walked for so long.Although it was not yet noon, Wang Ye was already hungry.

To make rice, I took out the big pot I bought from the supply and marketing cooperative in the space, found a pile of stones to build a simple earth stove, and then found a dead tree, put it into the space, and processed it into firewood instantly.It's a pleasure to skin and clean the prey in one go.

At this moment, Wang Ye didn't say that the space was only 9 yuan with free shipping.Now there is no need to pay too much attention to the taste, pheasant and rabbit can be cooked in one pot.Some people may ask, why not bake it?The answer is simple, I’m tired, too tired, I don’t have time to bake!

After gathering everything, I made a pot lid out of wood in the space and started stewing.After everything was done, Wang Ye was too tired to move.Leaning under a big tree, I began to close my eyes and meditate. This was something I didn’t dare to sleep in the mountains.If some uninvited guest comes, your life will be at stake.

It was almost noon, and a rich aroma came from the pot.Lift the pot and start eating.For a moment, there was a storm, and after an hour or so, there was a burp.I'm full, I'm so full.

After eating and drinking, Wang Ye put the remaining meat and the pot into the space.Wang Ye picked up his spear and hatchet and continued to look for prey while strolling. Along the way, he caught a lot of things, but only small things like pheasants and hares.While walking, I came to a valley. Before my mental energy could detect it, I saw a group of wild boars walking along the valley.

Wang Ye followed him quietly. When he saw it from a distance, he saw two big ones and five small ones. Wang Ye thought: "Good guy, this is a family!"

The big wild boar weighs two hundred kilograms, and the small one weighs forty or fifty kilograms.Wang Ye thought: "If we shoot, even if we shoot one head, it will only be two big ones at most. The remaining five heads will weigh more than 200 kilograms!"

In the spirit of shameful waste, Wang Ye wanted to continue to follow and look for opportunities.

This walk takes about an hour.Just when Wang Ye was about to lose his patience, the group of wild boars came to the end of the valley.Wang Ye looked at the scene in front of him. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, a small waterfall flowed down from the mountain. Wang Ye hid behind a huge rock and observed.The small waterfall fell to form a pool, surrounded by lush water and grass. It seemed that this group of wild boars often came here to feed.

The wild boars were very vigilant. When they noticed some movement here, they all raised their heads and looked in the direction of Wang Ye.Wang Ye held his breath and remained motionless.Fortunately, the wild boar watched for a while and found no danger, so it lowered its head to eat grass and drink water.The mouth of the valley was more than thirty meters wide. Wang Ye struggled to climb up a boulder more than three meters high at the mouth of the valley.

After ensuring their own safety, they raised their guns and fired, hitting their heads. The wild boars had no way to escape and could only run towards the mouth of the valley. After five shots, only one big and one small were left. They were about to run to the mouth of the valley, wipe!There are no bullets, and the 38 cap can only hold five bullets.

If they had been reloaded, these two would have disappeared long ago. It was too late, but it was so fast. Wang Ye thought: "How can I make you run away from me if I ride a horse with enough space to kill you?"
